t: Kraft Heinz will split back into 2 companies a decade after merger | PBS News
s: September 2, 2025 - One of the companies, currently called Global Taste Elevation Co., will include brands such as Heinz, Philadelphia cream cheese and Kraft Mac & Cheese, Kraft Heinz said Tuesday.
